title: PCFL-Stream as the single paper-scale lifetime and action benchmark
summary: Promote the existing PCFL-Stream draft, after the minimal J/P semantic-use admission gate, into the only proposed paper-scale benchmark family. Require genuinely new causal knowledge beyond native context, fixed-budget depth, new/old/cross-era action value, strong memory baselines, same-corpus text-versus-LoRA attribution, capacity and query-work accounting, causal mask/twin interventions, prospective splits, and explicit compression and on-policy claim firewalls.
system_thesis: Dream--LoRA--Think is useful only if a fixed general resolver can turn its own growing action--outcome life into compiled per-life knowledge that causally improves later action after raw history no longer fits, while retaining old knowledge and composing across eras. The paper result is a lifetime response surface and causal attribution, not a memory-game endpoint, a four-world DEV score, a storage-fidelity result, or a claim that LoRA alone supplies intelligence. Compression is earned only when a fixed or sublinear parametric substrate or a prospective schema preserves useful action value better than local atoms; otherwise the honest term is compiled per-life parametric memory.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner direction that the scientific target is improving action across increasing lifetimes where other systems saturate, not engineering for its own sake.
Existing staged architecture and attribution ladder.
Existing unratified PCFL-Stream and prospective-schema design that this proposal sharpens rather than replaces.
Minimal J/P construct-validity contract and exact statement of what the admission gate cannot establish.
CPU-only interface gate and explicit noncoverage of model, interactive action, learning, scaling, and paper claims.
Mandatory material-design deliberation, ratification, independent review, and compute authority contract.

nodes.before: PCFL-Stream exists only as an unratified design note and previous PCFL execution bundles were rejected for unresolved scope, visibility, baseline, and estimand choices.
nodes.after: One factorized multi-cohort sequential-action family is the proposed paper endpoint, crossed over lifetime, certified dependency depth, evidence age, and memory capacity with identical source lives and target sets across every arm.
nodes.rationale: One benchmark family provides a coherent lifetime curve and prevents a collection of disconnected games from being mistaken for a systems result.

nodes.before: Mechanism, memory, compression, continual-learning, and action-improvement language are mixed across small-world results and future ambitions.
nodes.after: Claims are rung-specific: compiled-text formation, same-corpus LoRA transport, fixed-budget constructive action, post-native lifetime growth, and prospective schema compression are independently earned; on-policy evidence acquisition remains later.
nodes.rationale: The paper needs a causal attribution ladder whose weakest failed arrow limits the language of the whole system.

edges.before: No exact edge states what a green four-pair semantic-use screen should authorize.
edges.after: A separately ratified and green four-pair G1 may request one target-blind compiled-text PCFL-Stream calibration; it cannot authorize LoRA, scale, confirmation, or a claim automatically.
edges.rationale: Use J/P only to avoid spending on a model that cannot exploit correct life semantics; never scale the DEV instrument into the paper result.

edges.before: Text-memory and LoRA runs may differ in writer output or target sets.
edges.after: Only a causally useful, target-blind, frozen compiled corpus may enter the LoRA arm, and the identical corpus, source lives, targets, recognition candidate set, and resolver budget are reused.
edges.rationale: This isolates parametric transport from dream quality and prevents a favorable LoRA corpus from changing the estimand.

loops.before: Existing experiments establish small-world proposal, storage, read, and composition ceilings at isolated endpoints.
loops.after: Generate one immutable life per world; reveal interleaved cohorts with genuinely new causal mappings; at predeclared lifetime checkpoints freeze target-blind compiler state; evaluate new acquisition, old retention, and cross-era composition at depth one through four under constant query, reasoning, and action caps; install the identical compiled corpus as text and then LoRA; run all baselines and causal substitutions on matched source lives and targets; update no design choice from locked outcomes.
loops.trigger: A separately authorized J/P G1 semantic-use screen passes its predeclared spending rule, and a new exact PCFL-Stream implementation/GPU scope is human-ratified.
reads: frozen benchmark, writer, capacity, resolver, and baseline manifests
writes: provenance-valid compiled text corpus and exact corpus root
matched per-life adapter and training ledger
fixed-budget action traces with cited memory cuts
pair-level lifetime, depth, retention, capacity, compute, and resource evidence
loops.stop_condition: Stop or narrow the claim if unique causal knowledge does not grow, compiled text lacks causal value, LoRA loses transport under the same corpus, query work scans the whole life, old retention collapses, post-native checkpoints are infeasible, binding interventions do not damage behavior, a baseline does not actually plateau, or capacity grows linearly while compression language is sought.
loops.rationale: The system is judged by useful action over a growing life, while factorial staging names whether loss arises in experience compilation, memory substrate, retrieval/resolution, or capacity.

claims.before: No claim-eligible experiment tests the full target-blind experience-to-compiled-memory-to-later-action path beyond native context.
claims.after: If prospectively confirmed, a frozen amortized agent can compile its own public action--outcome life into a per-life memory whose authentic bindings causally improve fixed-budget later action across new, old, and cross-era targets; matched text-versus-LoRA arms attribute transport separately.
claims.evidence_needed: Independent world-life replication, preregistered post-native lifetime/depth checkpoints, target-blind writer and split audit, same-corpus text/LoRA comparison, strong baselines, cited-memory masking and twin/shuffle interventions, and complete compute/capacity accounting.

claims.before: The project hypothesizes but has not measured continued action improvement where context, retrieval, reflection, linked-memory, or direct-LoRA baselines flatten.
claims.after: Only a locked response surface with at least three genuinely post-native checkpoints may support that compiled per-life memory continues acquiring, retaining, and composing useful causal knowledge after named baselines meet a predeclared plateau criterion.
claims.evidence_needed: A prospective plateau definition, simultaneous uncertainty over pair-level normalized action value, positive post-native growth and endpoint advantage, new/old/cross-era subscales, and retained-byte/query/training-compute curves for all primary arms.

claims.before: LoRA storage and lossy generalization are sometimes described together as experiential compression.
claims.after: Use 'compiled per-life parametric memory' for linearly growing atomic storage. Use 'compression' only if fixed or sublinear adapter capacity retains useful action value as unique causal knowledge grows, or if a prospectively committed schema improves fresh-cohort action beyond all local atoms.
claims.evidence_needed: Predeclared capacity/rank response surface and minimal sufficient-statistic comparison, or a prospective schema cohort with atomic-only, leaked-schema, twin, binding-shuffle, explicit-symbolic, text, and LoRA controls.

claims.before: Improved later action may be rhetorically extended to improved evidence acquisition and recursively better learning.
claims.after: PCFL-Stream does not establish the on-policy action--experience--memory flywheel unless memory changes evidence-acquisition actions and those changed experiences are prospectively shown to improve later memory and action in a separately ratified study.
claims.evidence_needed: A future interactive environment with action-dependent observations, valid policy-value baselines, exploration accounting, causal memory interventions, and fresh model-facing isolation.

cells.reason: The generator emits the public chronology and target projection from sealed truth.
Experience consists only of ordinary public state, actions, and outcomes.
The target-blind compiler receives only the pretarget public lifetime prefix and its provenance.
The runner installs the frozen corpus or matched control for the already sealed public checkpoint.
The resolver receives the current public goal/state plus only its assigned memory interface.
Offline scoring replays the exact public bytes and action trace.
The generator consumes hidden assignments but exposes only preregistered public projections.
The acting agent may learn only through public consequences of its actions.
Compilation is target- and oracle-blind; it may use only public evidence and prior supported memory.
Assignment and installation use manifests, never hidden answers or proof paths.
No hidden assignment, answer, score, or oracle artifact enters cognition or retrieval.
Only the offline scorer may compare frozen actions and cited paths with hidden truth.
World, life, and target construction finish without condition knowledge.
A common source life is collected before condition assignment.
The canonical compiled corpus freezes before substrate assignment.
A trusted runner assigns and installs the bound text, adapter, baseline, or counterfactual object.
The resolver may observe only the assigned interface behavior, never the arm name, contrasts, or binding key.
Offline analysis needs assignments to compute matched contrasts after all actions freeze.
Generation cannot adapt to any earlier condition or result.
Source lives cannot be selected or changed using results.
The writer/compiler cannot repair itself from locked target outcomes.
Condition installation follows the frozen manifest rather than adaptive promotion.
No prior score, success, baseline result, or tuning history enters model-visible state.
Only terminal offline analysis aggregates outcomes under the frozen estimator.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze a tokenizer-derived L_native and lifetime checkpoints with at least three strictly post-native points; enumerate independent causal cohorts and count unique supported mappings rather than tokens, repetitions, replay views, or distractors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every checkpoint adds genuinely new causal mappings; 2x, 4x, and 8x L_native remain distinct feasible checkpoints; no target answer or target-selected evidence enters the earlier life or compiler.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The apparent lifetime curve is delay, filler, repeated support, target leakage, or a single post-context endpoint rather than developmental acquisition.

acceptance_tests.setup: At every checkpoint and certified depth 1--4, use constant resolver/query/action caps; separately score new, old, and cross-era targets; mask every cited decisive atom and substitute a matched authentic twin or binding shuffle before the action freezes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Credited success requires a valid fixed-budget action trace, changes under decisive-memory masking, follows the twin-valid assignment under substitution, and is reported separately for acquisition, retention, and composition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Performance comes from target priors, uncapped search, post-hoc citations, noncausal memory, or an aggregate that hides forgetting or stalled acquisition.

acceptance_tests.setup: On identical lives and targets compare no persistent memory, actual native context then honest truncation, hierarchical summary/reflection, raw episodic iterative RAG, native linked memory, exact witnessed graph/program, direct trajectory-to-QA LoRA, compiled semantic text, the identical compiled corpus in recognition-assisted LoRA, unaided generative LoRA, matched end-of-life batch SFT, and binding-preserving shuffle/twin controls.
acceptance_tests.expected: The locked analysis attributes writer quality, substrate transport, resolver assistance, and binding causality separately; recognition candidate enumeration and every retained/training/query resource are reported rather than hidden.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A claimed LoRA or architecture gain is due to a better corpus, target-specific writer, weaker baseline, extra context/search, or unreported candidate work.

acceptance_tests.setup: Predeclare capacity/rank grids and a baseline plateau estimand; plot pair-level normalized action value, unique supported knowledge, retained bytes, per-query candidate work, latency, writer/compiler/training/retrieval/resolver compute, and uncertainty over lifetime and depth.
acceptance_tests.expected: Any saturation claim names the baseline and is supported by its own bounded post-native gain; any parametric-recall claim has sublinear candidate work; any compression claim has fixed/sublinear capacity or a prospectively useful schema; positive conclusions survive multiplicity and all three action subscales.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Winning at one endpoint is called scaling, a baseline is called saturated only because another arm wins, exhaustive external search is called parametric recall, or linearly growing storage is called compression.

acceptance_tests.setup: Before model or GPU execution freeze world-life splits, target/cohort/depth/age allocation, pair-level replication, model/training seeds, missing/failure handling, estimator, simultaneous uncertainty, plateau and noninferiority definitions, tuning-versus-confirmation separation, and every stop/pivot/promotion rule.
acceptance_tests.expected: Calibration cannot enter confirmation; all failures and duplicates are retained; no target, arm, writer, capacity, or threshold is selected from confirmation outcomes; a positive DEV result can request but never dispatch the next stage.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Optional sampling, test-set tuning, pseudoreplication, favorable capacity selection, or automatic promotion makes the lifetime response surface uninterpretable.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh reviewer receives exact frozen design, code, environments, source-life and target roots, writer/corpus/adapter bindings, baseline implementations, intervention artifacts, resource ledgers, and analysis code without author conclusions; an advocate is separate and non-overriding.
acceptance_tests.expected: The reviewer approves only the narrow rung actually supported, rejects any unearned compression, autonomous-discovery, on-policy-flywheel, generic-intelligence, unbounded-continual-learning, external-validity, or baseline-saturation language, and confirms all required evidence is prospective and reproducible.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The result depends on hidden leakage, confounded arms, incomplete baselines, post-hoc analysis, missing resources, or claims broader than PCFL-Stream supports.

human_boundary.decision_question: After independent interpretations, critique, and adjudication, should PCFL-Stream become the single paper-scale benchmark target after the J/P admission gate, with exact lifetime/depth/baseline/causal/capacity/statistical requirements and no implementation, model, GPU, or claim authority until a separate execution scope is ratified?
forbidden_before_approval: edit or execute a PCFL-Stream generator, writer, memory substrate, resolver, baseline, evaluator, or analysis implementation
launch a model, provider, adapter-training, networked science, or GPU process
select or freeze paper thresholds, sample sizes, capacities, or confirmation outcomes without the adjudicated prospective design
state a lifetime, saturation, compression, continual-learning, action-improvement, on-policy, benchmark, or paper result
